name: TL;DR
prompt: Give me a tl;dr of this recording in 2-3 sentences. Be concise.

name: What did I miss?
prompt: What were the most important points? Give me a short bullet list (max 5 items).

name: Action items
prompt: List action items from this recording as a short bullet list. Include owner if mentioned. No extra commentary.

name: Key decisions
prompt: List decisions made in this meeting as a short bullet list. No extra commentary.

name: Open questions
prompt: List unresolved questions or follow-ups as a short bullet list. No extra commentary.
